spec_match.rationale: The structure table (state/protocol/cipherSuite/keyExchangeGroup/certificates[]) and the enterprise use-case samples (getSecurityInfo with certificateInfo:'full', pinning, indicator UI) plausibly track the API, but everything is static prose.

interactive.rationale: No real controls at all — a static structure table plus code cards, with only the generic scenario-focus walkthrough bolted on; this is the static-card pattern the project forbids, and the sibling security-info-explorer proves the interactive version of this exact content already exists.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises showing the structure of WebRequest.SecurityInfo; the page does that — the problem is the medium, not the match.

edge_cases.rationale: Documents secure/insecure/broken states and legacy-TLS handling in prose/code, but none of it is demonstrable on the page.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5076692209106944 and the sibling concepts.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite covers environment surfaces; nothing on this page is executable to assert.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Load verified with screenshots, DOM dump, and clean console on both viewports; there are no feature controls to drive.

telemetry_health.rationale: Server-injected /public/demo-telemetry.js verified in the served DOM.

design_system.rationale: Structure table and code blocks follow the shared variables.

accessibility.rationale: Semantic rows, aria-labelledby walkthrough with aria-live output; static content is otherwise screen-reader friendly.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-measured at 360px: an info-value reaches 377px (~17px clipped); minor, the rest holds.

openQuestions.title: Give the structure real interactivity
openQuestions.detail: The page is a static code-card (forbidden pattern) whose interactive twin already exists at ../security-info-explorer/. Make each structure row expandable with the explorer's field descriptions and classifications, or embed a mini field-inspector fed by one sample object — keeping this page's URL and identity (additive in-place upgrade, no new slug needed).

openQuestions.title: Fix 17px mobile clip on info values
openQuestions.detail: At 360px one .info-value reaches 377px and is clipped; allow wrapping.

summary: Content is accurate and well-presented, but it is a static structure card with zero real interactivity — precisely the pattern the project bans — while its sibling explorer already demonstrates the interactive treatment. Merge that interactivity in-place; layouts otherwise verified near-clean on both viewports. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI (screenshot + DOM dump) and raw CDP (real click dispatch, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile emulation) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so v145-only API paths were validated on their fallback branches, not the new-API success path. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental (blocked host) and was not counted against any page.
